messages:
Maria: FYI I found ~120 RoleBindings created by the rbac-migrator run last night that give `infra-admin` to service accounts tagged `rebinder-feb26`. Many of the k8s audit events have no `actor` field.
Ashok: timeline? which pipeline executed the migrator?
Maria: CI triggered it: rbac-migrator v2 ran 2026-02-18T03:12:05Z (CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345). Deploy bot shows success.
deploy-bot: rbac-migrator v2 finished job/infra/rbac-migrator/2026-02-18T03:12:05Z status=success
Jon: even if CI invoked the job, we should still see an actor. paste a sample audit row.
Maria: sample audit row below — note null actor and author_source empty:
```
{"ts":"2026-02-18T03:12:06Z","resource":"RoleBinding/infra-admin:svc-ops-17","action":"bind","actor":null,"meta":{"job":"rbac-migrator","kms_signer":"projects/rdw/keyrings/rbac/keys/migrator"}}
```
Ashok: kms_signer present but no actor. Our enrichment service maps KMS signer -> principal; was that pipeline running in prod-eu at 03:10-03:20?
Maria: enrichment indexer was rolled back in prod-eu last week to mitigate a different bug. Looks like enrichment was disabled during that window.
Auditor-bot: SIEM alert created: RBAC_BINDING_ANOMALY - 120 binds missing actor. Ticket SIEM-9901
Sara: opened compliance ticket CT-2026-058 and put a legal/retention hold on related logs.
Jon: immediate risk: infra-admin is broad. Can we revoke the transient bindings while we investigate?
Maria: doing a scoped dry-run then revoke: `./scripts/revoke-svc-bindings --label rebinder-feb26 --dry-run`
```
# dry run (truncated)
svc-ops-17 (ns infra) -> unbind infra-admin
svc-svc-09 (ns infra) -> unbind infra-admin
... total 120 targets
```
Maria: executed live revoke, removed 120 RoleBindings. K8s events show RoleBinding.delete entries; will attach audit lines when available.
Ashok: grabbing migrator logs + KMS envelope logs to identify who signed the request. Need to know if this was CI token or human-run.
Maria: migrator log: git sha b4f2, runner runner-ops-03, invoked by deploy-bot job token. Full logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/rbac-migrator/2026-02-18/12345
Ashok: KMS logs show `projects/rdw/serviceAccounts/migrator-sa` signed envelopes at 2026-02-18T03:12:04Z. That maps to the migrator service account. Now need CI token audit to see who triggered that job.
Jon: plan: (1) reconstruct initiator (CI + vault token audit), (2) backfill audit events mapping kms_signer -> actor, (3) enforce migrator to hard-fail when enrichment returns null actor, (4) add post-run integrity check comparing emitted audit rows vs actual RBAC state.
Ashok: I'll own (1) and (2). Starting KMS + CI audit queries now. Backfill command: `python tools/backfill_audit.py --source=k8s_events --kms=/s3/kms/2026-02-18/ --out=backfill-feb26.csv`
Sara: I'll update compliance artifacts and log retention. Adding CT-2026-058 notes and required evidence.
Maria: opened hotfix PR to add actor-check + telemetry: https://github.com/redwood/rbac-migrator/pull/672 — scheduling hotfix deploy today. Also adding config flag to switch fail-open -> fail-closed.
Jon: escalate to sec-ops if CI token shows unexpected usage. If not, this is regression from enrichment rollback.
Ashok: update: enrichment indexer was disabled in prod-eu between 03:05 and 03:25 due to a rollback. Backfill in progress, ingesting to SIEM.
Maria: leaving thread open for backfill results and compliance confirmation. Assigning owners: Ashok (audit backfill), Jon (migrator hardening), Sara (compliance).
Sara: compliance acknowledged CT-2026-058, will post status update in 2 hours.
Jon: add automated check to our CI gate: migrator runs must have non-null actor in audit events before accepting the run as complete.
Maria: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rbac-incident under "missing-audit-actor" steps.
Auditor-bot: Created SIEM evidence bundle attached to SIEM-9901.
Maria: thanks everyone, closing the immediate blast but keeping channel for remediation artifacts and final RCA.
